verify.note: Closed 2026-09-30 (ADR-1685). Measures the consequence from the code: the rail body mounts EntityRailDataProvider, the provider makes the one getEntityRailBundle request, the bundle is a use server action that runs its reads once each with Promise.allSettled and carries reads for all five kinds; no circle, event, hub, nexus or practice module file makes its own first request (a mount effect calling a get* getter, a module-level guided resolve, or a direct getEventCoreStats), except hub.layout and nexus.layout while the registry keeps them render: link; every useEntityRailRead call site passes the getter the bundle runs for that kind and read, every bundled read has a consuming call site, and at least 25 call sites exist. Fails on main (451c500f0) at the first arm (entity-rail-data.tsx is gone), and with the provider files alone copied onto main it names all 25 unwired module files. Runs in about 40 ms.

append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-30 (ADR-1685). PREMISE HELD at 451c500f0 (main): space-rail-data.tsx was the only rail bundle provider, and every inline module on a circle, event, hub, nexus or practice rail called its own use server getter on mount. Next.js sends Server Actions one at a time per client, so those reads queued, and several were the same read (getCircleAdminData three times on a circle rail, getEventAdminData three times on an event rail). WHAT CHANGED. lib/admin/entity-rail-reads.ts names the reads each rail module makes; components/admin/modules/entity-rail-actions.ts (getEntityRailBundle) runs the mounted modules' reads once each, in parallel, in ONE request, through the same gated getters; components/admin/modules/entity-rail-data.tsx (EntityRailDataProvider + useEntityRailRead) wraps the rail body's sections in admin-bar-body.tsx and serves each module its slice, falling back to the module's own getter outside the provider, on another entity, for an unrequested or failed read, or a failed bundle. 25 module files route their first read through the hook (26 call sites); reloads after a write still call the getter. BEFORE AND AFTER (requests a manager's full rail sends on open): circle 10 to 1, event 5 to 1, hub 4 to 1, nexus 4 to 1, practice 3 to 1; getter runs on the server circle 10 to 8, event 5 to 3, hub 4 to 3, nexus 4 to 3, practice 3 to 2. The hub reading is measured in entity-rail-data.test.tsx with the four real hub modules (4 getter requests to 1 bundle, same data on screen); the rest are counted from the table and the module files. Same data and the same gates: the bundle calls the same getter with the same key, and each getter still returns null for a viewer without its capability. Left, and named in the ADR: React.cache() does not dedupe inside a Server Action, so each getter run still resolves the viewer for itself. No migration.
